notes.title: 💥 They’re back and badass as ever, both in standard and VR versions 💥
notes.content:
Hello Soldier,

[b]The iconic action rail shooter is back![/b]

Released back in 1987 in arcade, [i]Operation Wolf Returns: First Mission[/i] adopts the same DNA as in the original game with a design rehaul! Relive this great Arcade classic through non-stop action, [b]both in standard and VR versions[/b]!

[previewyoutube=KlwqbSpnt_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

🎨 New artistic direction
🗯️ Addition of parody style voices
🔫 Gameplay focused on non-stop action
👥 A campaign that can be played alone or with two players ([b]solo mode available only in VR[/b])
💪 Survival mode (fighting waves of enemies)

🐺 [b]Play Operation Wolf Returns: First Mission now![/b]
